definitions.explanation: A state of tranquility or freedom from war.

examples.japanese: {平和|へいわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{平和|へいわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
{平和|へいわ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a peaceful life.

notes:
{平和|へいわ} refers to a state of peace, tranquility, or freedom from conflict. It functions both as a noun and as a な-adjective.

USAGE:
- As noun: {平和|へいわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to protect peace)
- As な-adjective: {平和|へいわ}な⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (peaceful world)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{平和|へいわ}: world peace
- {平和|へいわ}な⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: peaceful era
- {平和|へいわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧: to wish for peace
- {平和|へいわ}⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧: peace treaty

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{平和的|へいわてき}→平和的：noentry⟧: peaceful (な-adjective, emphasizes manner)
- ⟦{平和主義|へいわしゅぎ}→平和主義：noentry⟧: pacifism
- ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧: war (opposite)
